svg.title: The LLM video-agent stack for video generation and video world models
svg.desc: Four task types (code-rendered video, video-model generation, editing, video world models) feed an agent loop of harness, backbone, editable artifact and execution. W1 emits the artifact in one pass and W2 inserts a fixed plan; W3 returns inspection feedback to change a later draft; W4 receives fresh actions and observations from an environment or user. Evaluation identifies the full configuration before isolating components.
svg.text: W1 emits the artifact in one pass · W2 adds a fixed plan
reaches the model in W3 and W4
new actions, revisits, interventions and edits arrive while the task continues
classify the task first, then its outer loop
Memory, several agents or a running engine alone do not make a configuration W4;
feedback that only updates skills for later tasks is adaptation, not W3 repair.
full configuration first, then components: delivery · fidelity · behavior · preservation · cost
